verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 has a dedicated snapshot/restore doc page covering the full story. It checkpoints an initialized workspace, claims new sandboxes from that snapshot (also shown with snapshot IDs for parallel tasks), rolls an existing sandbox back, and forks a running or paused sandbox into another sandbox. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that snapshot/restore/fork works as documented, and clarity on whether snapshots capture process/memory state beyond the filesystem.

support.subject: As a developer, I can snapshot a sandbox and later restore or fork new sandboxes from that snapshot

citations.quote: checkpoint an initialized workspace, claim new sandboxes from that known filesystem state, roll an existing sandbox back
fork a running or paused sandbox into another paused sandbox
Claim additional sandboxes with that snapshot ID for parallel tasks.
